content.comment_body: Hello, is there a command to set or reset outputs and flags in [product_name] [version_no]?
It is only possible to set or reset latching or pulse relays directly. Outputs and flags do not retain their state automatically.

Hi [user_name], In addition to latching relays, controlling the state of flags or outputs depends on the specific circuit setup. If you can share an example circuit you want to switch, we could assist further. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about direct commands for setting or resetting outputs and flags within [company_name]'s logic controller software. Replies clarify that only relay elements can be manipulated this way, while outputs and flags lack state retention in the given version. There appears to be some confusion about whether outputs/flags can be influenced by specific circuit designs, suggesting possible gaps in documentation or tool clarity.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a simple method or command to programmatically set or reset outputs and flags, with functionality similar to relays, for flexible automation.
